Layer: `std`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Manual timerfd owner: close exactly once, never retried. Clock, kind and setting checks precede host calls. Alarm timers need CAP_WAKE_ALARM. Evidence is finite native Linux x86_64 CPU execution.
